subject: Updating other tabs from another tab's input

messages.author: 07ec57a49154e44a
messages.subject: Updating other tabs from another tab's input
parts:
Hi,

I am pretty new in developing at Shiny, so I am aware that my knowledge is quite limited. It'll be obvious after reading my thread though.


Current application:
TAB 1 - Image
TAB 2 - Screeplot
TAB 3 - Loadings
TAB 4 - BiPlot
TAB 5 - Explained Variance

CONTROL 1 - Number of PCs
CONTROL 2 - Selecting picture
CONTROL 3 - Corr/Covariance
CONTROL 4 - Red / Green / Blue

I have a picture decomposition app, with Principal Components. A user can interact with selecting another picture OR changing the number of components OR selecting Correlation/Covariance matrix. All the tabs are linked together, as all analyse the IMAGE data itself.
All works well, if the user change any control parameters on the first tab where the picture is rendered. In this case all the tabs are updated, and shows different values. However, if i select another tab, and change a control parameter, nothing happens. 

Currently, all the code Server side code is inside the "output$result <- renderImage({ }" rendering, which is causing the problem. I tried to put the other outputs (e.g."output$table_exp <- renderTable({table_exp})") outside from this render image function, but I gained nothing. 

I am not sure if i should put something to "observe" or not. To be honest, it is a bit blurry for now.

Thanks for any comments.

Andras
